mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.event_type AS eventType, n.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, n.ref_id AS refId, n.title, n.deep_link AS deepLink, n.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN n.read_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS `read` FROM user_notification n LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = n.course_id WHERE n.recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, recipient_user_id AS recipientUserId, course_id AS courseId, event_type AS eventType, ref_id AS refId, title, deep_link AS deepLink, created_at AS createdAt, read_at AS readAt FROM user_notification WHERE id = #{id}
